# ICMPv6 (`icmpv6`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 4 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [Multicast control protocols](../../protocols/multicast.md)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `enum(8)` | `128` (echo_request) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | Message type. |
| `code` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   | Message code, meaning depends on the type. |
| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum with pseudo header over the header and everything after it | Internet checksum with the IPv6 pseudo header over header and payload (Auto). |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 130 (0x82) | [`mldv2_query`](mldv2_query.md) | at least 24 octets remaining |
| 128 (0x80) | [`icmpv6_echo`](icmpv6_echo.md) |   |
| 129 (0x81) | [`icmpv6_echo`](icmpv6_echo.md) |   |
| 130 (0x82) | [`mld`](mld.md) |   |
| 131 (0x83) | [`mld`](mld.md) |   |
| 132 (0x84) | [`mld`](mld.md) |   |
| 143 (0x8f) | [`mldv2_report`](mldv2_report.md) |   |
| 133 (0x85) | [`ndp_rs`](ndp_rs.md) |   |
| 134 (0x86) | [`ndp_ra`](ndp_ra.md) |   |
| 135 (0x87) | [`ndp_ns`](ndp_ns.md) |   |
| 136 (0x88) | [`ndp_na`](ndp_na.md) |   |
| 137 (0x89) | [`ndp_redirect`](ndp_redirect.md) |   |
